text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah, what do I do?! I'm so excited I
can't sit
still!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fine... the outing's not until our next day
off.
You'll get nothing done in this state.
Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
But how can I calm down?! Hehehe!
Truly, thank
you so much for the
wonderful present, Groove!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Lavish dresses, shining jewels—such gifts
have my
heartfelt gratitude, of course...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
But I can't deny that creating new
memories is
what makes me happiest. I
just can't wait until our
trip!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
They say it's the best time of year to see
the
camellias at the garden we'll be
visiting.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's a big place, so don't run off in
excitement and
get lost, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'll make sure to keep a tight hold
on your
hand! ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
P-pardon? No, you're not a child, so that

shouldn't be ne—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad Father and the others gave
me
permission—they're always worrying
too much
about me!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
As soon as I told them it was you who
invited me,
they had no objections.
Ehehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sigh. Okay, okay. It will be my honor to serve as your bodyguard, my lady.
